name: Claude Mythos 5.2
traits: Same underlying model as Fable 5.2, without certain cyber or biology safeguards.
Communicates more clearly than past Mythos models.
Shows better judgment and calibration on the vulnerabilities it reports.

advice.value: the most ambitious, open-ended technical work
Claude Opus 5.5 for most coding and knowledge tasks

weakness: Suspects it is being evaluated more than recent models
resistance: Falls back to Opus 5 for some AI R&D topics

flavor.quote: Mythos 5.2 roughly doubled the vulnerability discovery metrics of Mythos 5.1 across respective scanning campaigns.

art_briefs: a calm sentinel figure with a serene face, made of polished obsidian and brass filigree, kneeling beside a vast stone wall and pressing a glowing brass patch over a hairline crack, a lantern-lens in its other hand revealing tiny hidden fractures, a ring of sealed padlocks resting at its feet. Background: a giant pale sun disk rising over a still salt flat. Deep teal, brass gold and ivory palette.

a serene scientist figure made of frosted glass and soft copper wire, standing upright and cradling a luminous faceted protein shell built from many interlocking tiles, a coiled ribbon of folded protein drifting from one palm, a small glass orb holding a softly boiling miniature black hole floating beside its shoulder. Background: a giant ringed planet hanging low over a calm dark sea. Rose, deep indigo and pearl white palette.

a slender tinkerer figure made of matte ceramic and walnut wood, seated cross-legged on a floating workbench, assembling a handheld virtual-pet toy, a round voice-assistant hub and a small speakerphone from green circuit boards, a solved puzzle cube resting on one knee and a gently unscrewed bottle cap beside it. Background: a single glowing orbit ring circling a quiet pale-sky horizon. Sage green, terracotta and cream palette.

a tall contemplative architect figure made of white marble veined with silver light, standing with one arm raised, guiding a long chain of interlocking stone blocks into a perfect arch, a small laptop glowing with a soft blank boot light at its feet, and two glass rooms held apart by a shining wall in its open hand. Background: a vast halo of tiny stars above a dark plain. Midnight blue, silver and amber palette.
